==Skin Upgrades==
The '''Brawler''' has fourteen skins in total, those being:
#The Default skin.
#Six skins that can be unlocked from [[Crates]].
#Four skins that can be unlocked from [[Passes]].
#One skin that can be unlocked from [[Mission Quests]].
#One skin that can be unlocked from the [[Daily Store]].
#One skin that can be unlocked from [[Crates]] and [[Mission Quests]].
{{Tabber
|Default
|{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = Default
|Icon1 = [[File:DefaultBrawlerIconIGAug26.png|128px]]
|[[File:Brawler000.png|200px]]
|Tan skin, white hair with some strands having cyan ends, black tank top and shoes and blue jeans with black straps. Arms appear to be prosthetic and mechanical.
Has grey and black mechanical fists to attack enemies.
|[[File:Brawler001.png|200px]]
|Black goggles with reflective blue lens.
|[[File:Brawler002.png|200px]]
|Grey harness on torso.

Upgraded mechanical fists.
|[[File:Brawler003.png|200px]]
|Yellow coat that is tied around waist. Goggles gain an extra pair of light grey lens that cause z-fighting.
|[[File:Brawler004.png|200px]]
|Yellow bandana.

Mechanical fists gain more parts and finger segments become light orange.
|[[File:MaxBrawlerFromTDS.png|200px]]
|Legs now have mechanical feet attached and now wears a yellow and grey vest instead of a harness.
Yellow bandana and waist coat removed.

Mechanical fists are extended, gain a new exhaust, and more parts.
}}
|Blazing
|The {{Color|Premium|Blazing}} skin can be obtained from the [[Premium Crate|{{Color|Premium|Premium Crate}}]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Premium|Blazing}}
|Icon1 = [[File:BlazingBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:BlazingBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Red skin, white hair, red devil ears and horns, white pants, black and red shoes, white and red wrapping around arms and black shirt with red outlines.

Has black fists with neon outlines that create explosions to attack enemies.
|[[File:BlazingBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Black wrapping on arms that covers up the previous wrapping.
|[[File:BlazingBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Red rope around torso.

Pants are now red.

Shirt, shoes and wrapping now have yellow outlines.

Fists now has spikes on them.
|[[File:BlazingBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Necklace with black beads and white string and red glowing eyes.

Horns are now longer.

Hair now has a red to purple gradient.
|[[File:BlazingBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Pants are now blue, black and red.

Fists are now slightly larger with lighter neon outlines.
|[[File:BlazingBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Now floats in the air through flames that come out of its feet.

Fists are now extended.
}}
|Fallen
|The {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} skin can be obtained from [[Mission Quests]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}}
|Icon1 = [[File:FallenBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:FallenBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Body made out of blue crystals, dark blue torso, vest and pants, grey and blue shoes with blue crystals, brown belt with a grey buckle, grey and blue armbands, blue and grey helmet with blue flaming eyes.

Has blue crystalline arms to attack enemies.
|[[File:FallenBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Helmet now has a dark blue plume.
|[[File:FallenBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Dark blue and grey chestplate.

Armbands now have grey chains and blue crystals.
|[[File:FallenBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Grey and blue padding around waist.
|[[File:FallenBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Tattered brown cape.

Arms gain more spikes.
|[[File:FallenBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Blue crystals around shoes.

Extended chestplate.

Now wields brass knuckles.
}}
|Loader
|The {{Color|Deluxe|Loader}} skin can be obtained from the [[Deluxe Crate|{{Color|Deluxe|Deluxe Crate}}]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Deluxe|Loader}}
|Icon1 = [[File:LoaderBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:LoaderBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Tan skin, purple shirt and pants, dark purple shoes, black belt with a grey buckle and grey and purple helmet with a neon blue visor.

Has grey and blue mechanical fists that it uses to attack enemies.
|[[File:LoaderBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Black gloves.

Helmet now has a neon yellow visor.
|[[File:LoaderBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Grey vest.

Blue parts of the mechanical fists are now orange.
|[[File:LoaderBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Pants are now orange.
|[[File:LoaderBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Vest now has orange parts.

Helmet now has a brighter yellow visor.

Grey parts of the mechanical fists are now lighter.
|[[File:LoaderBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Legs now have mechanical feet attached.

Grey exoskeleton for mechanical fists.

Mechanical fists are now extended.
}}
|Rudolph
|The {{Color|OperationICE|Rudolph}} skin was obtained from Level 40 of the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]] regular track.
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|OperationICE|Rudolph}}
|Icon1 = [[File:RudolphBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:RudolphBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Brown and white reindeer with glowing red eyes and white nose, brown antlers and tail, white shirt with brown and gold harness, brown pants with white fur cuffs, and brown and yellow shoes.

Has brown and gold mechanical fists to attack enemies.
|[[File:RudolphBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Leather muzzle on nose.
|[[File:RudolphBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Red cloak with white fur.

Upgraded fists.
|[[File:RudolphBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Dark brown belt with gold accents and star.
|[[File:RudolphBrawler4.png|200px]]
|White fur around neck.

Fists now gain more gold parts and fingers are now gold.
|[[File:RudolphBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Yellow star knee-pads.

Antlers are now larger and have neon Christmas baubles.

Light brown hooves attached to legs.

Mechanical fists are now extended.
}}
|Jordan
|The {{Color|ContentCreator|Jordan}} skin is obtained from the [[Daily Store]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|ContentCreator|Jordan}}
|Icon1 = [[File:JordanBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:JordanBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Pale skin, brown hair, black fedora, black striped shirt with a skull in the middle, ripped brown jeans with leg buckles, and black and white shoes.

Has mechanical fists with thumbs up fingers to attack enemies.
|[[File:JordanBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Grey goggles with dark purple lenses.
|[[File:JordanBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Grey backpack.

Fists now have a gun stock attached to the bottom of them.
|[[File:JordanBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Grey tied coat around waist.
|[[File:JordanBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Molten corruption, which is a black rock body with neon orange magma, now covers a part of its face, its entire left arm and some of its torso.

Shirt now has red stripes, fedora is now red with horns coming out of lens, hair is now black and red.

Index fingers now have snipers attached them and are positioned slightly differently.
|[[File:JordanBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Entirely covered in molten corruption, replacing its clothing entirely.

Black crown, black and neon orange wings.

Black feet attached to its legs, making it taller.

Fists are now black claws with gun still attached on index fingers.
}}
|Lovestriker
|The {{Color|Lovestruck|Lovestriker}} skin is obtained through the [[Lovestruck Crate|{{Color|Lovestruck|Lovestruck Crate}}]] and the ''Heartbreaker'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Lovestruck|Lovestriker}}
|Icon1 = [[File:LovestrikerBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:LovestrikerBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Tan skin, white hair, longsleeves shirt, socks and shoes with pink soles, dark pink skirt, crimson ribbons between hair and shirt.

Has crimson boxing gloves strapped on hands to attack enemies.
|[[File:LovestrikerBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Sky blue jacket with light pink outline.
|[[File:LovestrikerBrawler2.png|200px]]
|White wings.

Increased number of straps for the boxing gloves, they are also now brighter.
|[[File:LovestrikerBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Pink knee-pads.
|[[File:LovestrikerBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Larger, pinkish-white wings.
|[[File:LovestrikerBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Jacket is now light beige.

Now has additional light pink feet, making it taller.

Even brighter straps on hands.
}}
|Lobster
|The {{Color|Surf|Lobster}} skin was obtained from Level 25 of the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] premium track.
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Surf|Lobster}}
|Icon1 = [[File:LobsterBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:LobsterBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Red lobster body, red hair, grey shirt, pants and shoes, brown apron.

Has giant lobster claws to attack enemies.
|[[File:LobsterBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Grey goggles on hair.
|[[File:LobsterBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Straps on apron.

Face markings.

Claws and tail now have spikes.
|[[File:LobsterBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Black belt.

Improved apron.
|[[File:LobsterBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Grey patches on apron.

Now has larger claws.
|[[File:LobsterBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Double tail.

Now has mechanical lobster legs, making it taller.

Now has even larger lobster claws.
}}
|Banned
|The {{Color|Banned|Banned}} skin is obtained from the [[Banned Crate|{{Color|Banned|Banned Crate}}]] 
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Banned|Banned}}
|Icon1 = [[File:BannedBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:BannedBrawlerLvl0.png|200px]]
|Corrupted black entity with neon purple scars and purple binary root covering its body.

Glowing purple eye and glitchy particles.

Emits purple light.

Has blackened gauntlets to attack enemies.
|[[File:BannedBrawlerLvl0.png|200px]]
|No changes.
|[[File:BannedBrawlerLvl0.png|200px]]
|No changes.
|[[File:BannedBrawlerLvl3.png|200px]]
|Purple-black gradient chestplate, with a spine-like structure on the back.
|[[File:BannedBrawlerLvl4.png|200px]]
|Palm has a small indent.

Gauntlets replaced with terrifying sharp claws.
|[[File:BannedBrawlerLvl5.png|200px]]
|Large horns, animalistic legs and floating binary shards.

Torso and head replaced with skeletal parts.

Claws now glow purple.
}}
|Werewolf
|The {{Color|Null|Werewolf}} skin was obtained from Level 30 of the [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battlepass|Null & Void Battlepass]] premium track.
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Null|Werewolf}}
|Icon1 = [[File:WerewolfBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:WerewolfBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Grey fur, neon green eyes, white teeth, grey tail, white claws, brown pants, metal neckguard and brown bandages around arms.

Has large mechanical claws to attack enemies.
|[[File:WerewolfBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Brown bandages around feet.

Yellow rings around tail.

Extended claws.
|[[File:WerewolfBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Black cables coming out of its head and more mechanical parts around its neck.

White bones on its shoulders.
|[[File:WerewolfBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Yellow mechanical left eye.

Metal rods sticking out of its back and an additional ring on its tail.

Small white bone on its torso and longer arms.

Claws now have tubes on them.
|[[File:WerewolfBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Brown belt and more metal parts on its head.

Two more rods coming out of its back and even more bones on its arms.

Head cables now have yellow ends.
|[[File:WerewolfBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Extended legs with golden claws and more brown bandages.

Now wears a proper robotic vest on its torso.

Tail replaced with a skeletal tail with no rings.

Head cables now have neon green lights on their ends.

Now has upgraded longer claws.
}}
|Horse
|The {{Color|LunarYear|Horse}} skin is obtained from the [[Lunar Crate|{{Color|LunarYear|Lunar Crate}}]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|LunarYear|Horse}}
|Icon1 = [[File:HorseBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:HorseBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Tan skin, brown horse ears, brown horse tail, brown hair, red sleeveless shirt, red pants, red hat and black shoes.

Has mechanical black, gold and red gauntlets to attack enemies.
|[[File:HorseBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Gold details on hat.
|[[File:HorseBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Black belt with a yin yang symbol, blue ribbon on back. 

Gauntlets now have spiked brass knuckles.
|[[File:HorseBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Green and yellow bands around legs and arms.
|[[File:HorseBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Green paper on its shirt and green collar.

Gauntlets now have more plates around them.
|[[File:HorseBrawler5.png|200px]]
|White vest, gold horseshoes on torso, red cloth.

Legs now have mechanical horse feet attached.

Gauntlets are now extended.
}}
|Bunny
|The {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}} skin was obtained from Level 22 of the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] premium track.
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}}
|Icon1 = [[File:BunnyBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:BunnyBrawler0.png|200px]]
|White fur, droopy bunny ears, light hair tied back in a bun, blue pants and overalls, light blue collared shirt and sleeves.

Has mechanical, pink and white gauntlets to attack enemies, strapped with pies.
|[[File:BunnyBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Brown belt.
|[[File:BunnyBrawler2.png|200px]]
|White and pink striped bands on sleeves and shirt.

Shirt collar removed.

Gauntlets now have blue claws that cause z-fighting.
|[[File:BunnyBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Pink scarf and brown gloves.
|[[File:BunnyBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Blue-banded sun hat and blue round glasses.
|[[File:BunnyBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Light orange bands around arms and wheat on mouth, orange and brown sandals.

Knee-pads with light orange eggs on them, sun hat now has a sunflower.

Upgraded gauntlets.
}}
|Scuba Ops
|The {{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops}} skin is obtained from the [[Scuba Ops Crate|{{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops Crate}}]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops}}
|Icon1 = [[File:ScubaOpsBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:ScubaOpsBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Pale skin, black diving hood, black mouthpiece, oxygen tank, orange and blue wetsuit, white gloves, white shoes, white shoulder pads, white pads around the hips.

Wields two rounded orange, black and white pincers.
|[[File:ScubaOpsBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Oxygen tank now has two canister.
|[[File:ScubaOpsBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Pincers are no longer white.
|[[File:ScubaOpsBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Two antennas on the sides of head.
|[[File:ScubaOpsBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Oxygen tank no longer has canisters.
|[[File:ScubaOpsBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Armored blue and orange pauldrons, clear material protecting the head, robotic three pronged pincers, blue and white armored gauntlets, two white antennas on the back, white extended and armored legs with a tube travelling from the thigh to the back.
}}
|Beach
|The {{Color|Beach}} skin is obtained from the [[Beach Crate|{{Color|Beach|Beach Crate}}]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Beach}}
|Icon1 = [[File:BeachBrawlerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:BeachBrawler0.png|200px]]
|Dark skin, turquoise hair, white towel, black tattoo of a palm tree and a sunburst symbol, green shorts and white sandals.

Has white boxing gloves with blue straps to attack enemies.
|[[File:BeachBrawler1.png|200px]]
|Black glasses.
|[[File:BeachBrawler2.png|200px]]
|Yellow tank top with the green text that reads "#3 TOWER" on it.

Upgraded boxing gloves.
|[[File:BeachBrawler3.png|200px]]
|Green and white swimming tube.
|[[File:BeachBrawler4.png|200px]]
|Grey anchor necklace.
|[[File:BeachBrawler5.png|200px]]
|Large blue, white and red popsicle on top of a box and small floaties on its feet.

No longer wears a tank top.

Upgraded boxing gloves.
}}
}}

==Skin Trivia==
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Loader}} skin is based on [https://riskofrain2.wiki.gg/Loader Loader] from ''Risk of Rain 2''.
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Jordan}} skin is based on the Roblox Content Creator [https://www.youtube.com/c/jordanstayt Jordan Stayt] with the Level 4 and 5 being based on one of his previous avatars.
**The cost of the skin is a reference to the 32 meme. It is referenced here due to the myth of it being a clue to activating the [[Hidden Wave]] becoming quite popular on one of his livestreams.
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Jordan}} skin has a low chance to emit a glitch effect similar to that of [[The32 Nametag]] when landing after using the ''Reposition'' ability.
*The {{Color|Lovestruck|Lovestriker}} skin is based on [https://lovebullet.wiki/wiki/Chiyo Chiyo] from ''Love Bullet''.
*The {{Color|Surf|Lobster}} skin is a submission from the [https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1D68qT3NUsa896BUM-KBc4FhRZp6NFVK6HXmaR7alHEg Aquatic Fantasy] skin set made by 4it3dm1 and InkEve.
**The skin was originally a human wearing a lobster costume. It would be changed into an anthropomorphic lobster when it was eventually added into the game. 
**According to the [[Brawler Lobster Charm]], the {{Color|Surf|Lobster}} skin is a '''Brawler''' tower fused with a lobster's might.
*The {{Color|LunarYear|Horse}} skin is likely based on [[w:c:umamusume:Special Week|Special Week]], [[w:c:umamusume:Vodka|Vodka]], and [[w:c:umamusume:Kitasan Black|Kitasan Black]] from ''Umamusume: Pretty Derby''.
*The {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}} skin's color scheme being similar to the transgender flag is completely unintentional.<ref>https://x.com/petloaches/status/2040170048229171308</ref><ref>https://archive.vn/zqmIL</ref>
*The {{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops}} skin was made by Linx<ref>https://x.com/LinxtheDev/status/2073078053920489822</ref> while its concept art was made by Loonimoff.<ref>https://x.com/Loonimoff_arts/status/2073074842979733787/photo/2</ref>
*The {{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops}} skin is based on the [[w:c:subnautica:Prawn Suit (Subnautica)|PRAWN Suit]] from ''Subnautica''.
*The {{Color|Beach}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/313445649/profile supereroulnoptizet].<ref>https://x.com/LinxtheDev/status/2085765772249362647</ref>

===Roblox Catalog===
*The {{Color|Banned|Banned}} skin's skull at Level 5 is the {{RLinkC|6552254|The Ice Skull of Nevermoor}}.
